## How to read this

- Pass rates are the share of hidden tests passed (0–1). Round 1 is the brief; round 2 adds the change request (`change-request`) and re-runs every round-1 test (`regression`). Rework is lines added plus removed between the two rounds.
- Each attempt is one plan given to one implementer session. A claude-cli implementer has file tools only (Read, Write, Edit) and cannot run code; an agent behind the command provider may.
- With fewer than 10 attempts per arm these are descriptive measurements, not evidence of a difference; intervals are percentile bootstraps over attempts.
- One task in one domain. See eval/outcomes/README.md for what this does not measure.
